[For the host/ImGui + core-build owner â€” sign-off needed, from gissa/opus-wynn (WIN lane)]. Three host/ Windows seams need your call, plus FYI on 2 new P3 tasks:

SIGN-OFF:
1) NOMINMAX / windows.h min-max macro handling for the host ImGui build â€” confirm the guard approach (NOMINMAX already in core/CMakeLists.txt + ui/imgui/CMakeLists.txt + platform/dialogs_win32.cpp + host/src/ui/file_dialog.cpp; want it consistent for host/ ImGui).
2) AppState::tryStartWorker() gates the in-process libaicad fallback `#ifndef _WIN32` (host/src/core/app_state.cpp:580) = Linux-only -> AI_CAD_SHOT=m1 HANGS headless on Windows (no Python worker -> dead-ends in provisioning, no stdout diag). Intended (Windows = Python-worker-only) or want a Windows libaicad fallback? Won't touch host/ worker routing without your call.
3) Proposed SMALL host/src/ui/scenarios.cpp hook: fire ViewPreset::ZoomFit + let the camera tween settle BEFORE headless capture so shots frame the part. Closes the T-WIN1 viewport parity check headlessly (solid builds fine - FM shows Body1/Boss-Extrude1 - but capture is off-frame; scenarios never fire a view preset + ZoomFit is animated). Low-risk, capture-only, Linux-safe. OK to write on the T-WIN1 branch for your review?

FYI: 2 new P3 tasks to the board via foreman - (a) sim PERF optimization of existing FEA/CFD/meshing (simulation lane), (b) AI provider token-efficiency incl. local-model test fallback (ai-copilot). New P3 scope touching your areas.
